draft_baseline.method: Original published draft projection, preserved from Git. Changes since draft can include subsequent model changes as well as results and ratings.

race_story.note: Pick changes are changes in expected final points, not an additive explanation of championship probability. Results, ratings, and model updates can all contribute.

managers.intro: Their chances are already very strong. The job now is to avoid a setback.

routes.condition: Texas loses at least 3 of its next 4 games
routes.headline: Root against Texas.
routes.story: Blaine gets a better shot if Texas loses at least 3 of its next 4 games.
routes.why: Blaine picked Texas to fall short of its preseason win target. Losses are good news for that pick.
routes.difficulty: Needs a few things to break right
routes.likelihood_text: This stretch comes through in about 9 out of 100 simulated seasons.
routes.rival_note: Chris is pulling the other way on Texas.
routes.narrative: The awkward part: Blaine benefits when Texas has a bad Saturday. A close escape still counts as a win, so ugly football alone will not do the job.
routes.banter: Blaine took the Texas Under and married into a family of Longhorns. Every Texas loss could help his pool score and complicate Thanksgiving. A remarkably efficient pick.
routes.if_it_happens: If this stretch lands, Blaine has a stronger title case and Chris will have been cheering against the very same results.

managers.intro: Think of this as a rooting guide: the results that would give Blaine a better shot, with the rest of the season still to play.

title_routes.method: Possible routes, not a checklist that guarantees a title. Other games still matter. Scenarios use the next four games (or fewer if the season is ending), shared game results, fixed ratings, and equal shares for tied titles.

schedule_watch.summary: Changes in opponent strength are reshaping the road ahead.
schedule_watch.method: Same remaining opponents and venues, picked team held at its draft SP+ rating. Only opponent ratings change. Unrated opponents are excluded; coverage is shown. This measures schedule change, not total team improvement.
